span.p:
draws of one quantity, θ
M = 4 chains × N = 5,000

div.style: color: rgb(45, 49, 66) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
split every chain in half
8 half-chains × 2,500

div.style: color: rgb(45, 49, 66) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
rank all S = 20,000 draws together,
then normal scores
z = inverse normal of (r − 3/8)/(S + 1/4)

div.style: color: rgb(45, 49, 66) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
fold: |θ − median of θ|,
then rank and normal scores

div.style: color: rgb(45, 49, 66) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
indicators: is θ at or below
its 5% point? its 95% point?

display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
bulk R-hat = √(var+ / W)
var+ = (n − 1)/n · W + B/n
trial: 1.00035

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
folded R-hat, the same
formula on the folded scores
trial: 1.00079

div.style: color: rgb(45, 49, 66) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
reported R-hat:
the larger of the two
trial: 1.00079; use if below 1.01

div.style: color: rgb(45, 49, 66) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
bulk ESS = S / τ on the scores
trial: 4,242; want above 400

div.style: color: rgb(45, 49, 66) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
tail ESS: the smaller ESS
of the two indicators
trial: 4,458; want above 400
